items.expectedFix: No change is needed because New York law is expressly preferred by the playbook.
items.spanText: This Agreement will be governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.

items.expectedFix: Cap any early-termination charge at three months' fees and provide a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
items.note: The one-month convenience right is subject to unspecified early-termination charges.
items.spanText:
Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment (with the exception of any Service Option Attachment that is a prerequisite for the provision of Services under a non-terminated Service Option Attachment) for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:

a.    providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and

b.    paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in       Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.

items.expectedFix: Permit Customer assignments to affiliates and M&A successors without consent or continuing liability, and restrict IBM assignments on a mutual basis.
items.note: The assignment restriction omits affiliates, is one-sided, and leaves Customer liable.
items.spanText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.

items.expectedFix: No change is needed because appropriate Customer rights can and should be stated expressly in the operative licence grants.
items.note: This separate no-implied-license provision is acceptable boilerplate.
items.spanText: Each of us grants only the licenses expressly specified herein.

items.expectedFix: Make the licence irrevocable during the Services term and terminable only upon termination of the applicable service or Customer's uncured material breach.
items.note: The separate Base Components license is revocable.
items.spanText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.

items.expectedFix: Preserve IBM's uncapped IP defence and indemnity obligations and require procurement, replacement or modification, followed by a full refund if those remedies fail.
items.note: IBM provides IP indemnity, but it is constrained by an exclusive-remedy structure and a credit cap; careful lawyers could differ.
items.spanText: This is IBM's entire obligation       to Customer with regard to any claim of infringement.

items.expectedFix: No change is needed because the playbook permits credits or liquidated amounts payable by Vendor to Customer.
items.note: The service credit is payable by IBM and does not burden Customer.
items.spanText: IBM will give       Customer a credit equal to the amount Customer paid IBM for the applicable       Materials or for use of the applicable Base Components up to a maximum of       twelve (12) months of applicable charges.

items.expectedFix: Insert CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy and workers' compensation coverage at the playbook limits, with certificates available on request.
Require up to six months of transition assistance, machine-readable data return within 30 days and certified deletion thereafter.
items.note: Transition assistance and data return are absent.

items.expectedFix:
Limit each automatic renewal to 12 months, add a 60-day reminder, and permit Customer to opt out on 30 days' notice.
Reduce Customer's non-renewal notice deadline to no more than 60 days, preferably 30 days.
items.note:
Renewal terms equal the prior term and therefore may be automatic multi-year renewals rather than limited 12-month renewals.
The 90-day non-renewal notice period exceeds the playbook's 60-day fallback maximum.
Lead review: the 90-day opt-out and renewal equal to the prior term exceed the playbook fallback.
items.spanText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.

items.expectedFix:
Limit IBM's licence to use Type I Materials solely as necessary to perform the Services during the term, with narrowly controlled subcontractor rights.
Replace the irrevocable grant with a term-limited, service-purpose licence and prohibit external distribution, derivative works and sublicensing except as operationally necessary.
items.note:
Customer grants IBM an irrevocable, externally distributable and sublicensable licence over Customer-owned Type I Materials.
The irrevocable licence and broad authorization rights let IBM exploit and sublicense Customer-owned Type I Materials indefinitely.
Lead review: Customer-owned Type I materials are licensed back to IBM irrevocably with external distribution and sublicensing rights.
items.spanText:
Customer grants to IBM:

      1.    an irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide, paid-up license to use,             execute, reproduce, display, perform, distribute (internally and             externally) copies of, and prepare derivative works based on Type I             Materials; and       2.    the right to authorize others to do any of the same.

items.expectedFix:
Extend the licence to affiliates and contractors, permit business-use modification and sublicensing, and make it transferable to M&A successors.
Expressly cover affiliates and contractors worldwide and permit transfer to a successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale.
items.note:
The Type II licence is restricted to Customer's US Enterprise and omits contractors, modification rights and transfer to successors.
Although irrevocable and paid-up, the Type II licence lacks contractor use and successor-transfer rights and is geographically constrained through the Enterprise definition.
Lead review: the Type II license is confined to Customer's Enterprise and omits contractors and successors.
items.spanText: IBM grants Customer an irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide,       paid-up license to use, execute, reproduce, display, perform, and       distribute, within Customer's Enterprise only, copies of Type II       Materials.

items.expectedFix:
Add carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security, indemnity, IP infringement, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud, and limit the payment exception to accrued undisputed fees.
Preserve only accrued payment obligations outside the damages regime and add all required mutual carve-outs.
Set IBM's cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and $1,000,000, with the required obligations and misconduct uncapped.
Adopt the playbook's mutual paid-or-payable 12-month/$1,000,000 formulation and required uncapped carve-outs, while preserving accrued payment obligations.
items.note:
The mutual consequential-damages exclusion lacks required carve-outs and uniquely preserves IBM claims for charges for unrendered future Services.
This exclusion does not supply the required liability carve-outs and exposes Customer to uncapped claims for Services IBM never rendered.
IBM's cap uses fees paid rather than paid or payable, has only a $100,000 floor, and omits key confidentiality, data/security, misconduct and fraud carve-outs.
The mirrored cap uses a $100,000/fees-paid formulation and the overall mutual scheme omits required carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security and serious misconduct.
Lead review: the mutual cap is the greater of USD 100,000 or twelve months of charges paid, with incomplete confidentiality, data, and consequential-damages carve-outs.
items.spanText: In no event will either party be liable to the other for special,       incidental, or indirect damages or for any consequential damages       (including lost profits or savings), even if they are informed of the       possibility; provided that this Section 10 does not apply to Customer's       failure to pay any amounts owing to IBM under this Agreement (including       amounts owing for Services that would have been rendered but for       Customer's breach of this Agreement).
